d:
Listen to this beautiful Hindi song "Sanchi Kahe Tore Aavan Se Hamre" with lyrics, sung by Jaspal Singh from the Bollywood Blockbuster Hindi movie "Nadiya Ke Paar" starring Sachin Pilgaonkar and Sadhana Singh in lead roles. Music by Ravindra Jain.
Credits:
Song: Sanchi Kahe Tore Aavan Se Hamre
Movie: Nadiya Ke Paar (1982)
Music: Ravindra Jain
Lyrics: Ravindra Jain
Director: Govind Moonis
Producer: Tarachand Barjatya
